% \etaEight \etaNine \betaNine \betaTen \nuEight \nuNine \etaPhiEight \etaPhiNine, and the same at N = 0..4 with the
% suffix Nzero .. Nfour (\betaNineNzero).  Large order: \ratioEight \ratioNine (|beta_(k+1)/beta_k| / a(k+b+1) at
% N = 1, k = 8, 9), \rawratioEight \rawratioNine (|beta_(k+1)/beta_k|).  \ledgerDate: date of the latest run in the
% ledger.  Negative and scientific values carry their own $...$ (the macros are used in text mode).
